Before PK-6b the residual calls `K.Raw_Decide`, `K.Context_Matches`, `K.Metadata_Base` and `K.Metadata_Matches` are not R-QUAL occurrences. Their selectors are not Appendix C simple names, and the removed names join the listed simple names only when PK-6b sets `CAPI_REMOVED_NAMES`, in the same packet as GE1–GE8.
- **One check function per rule.** Every rule of B0 has its own check function (B8.2).
- Type selections remain allowed: `K.Result`, `K.U32`, `K.Check_Row`, `K.Required_Row`, `K.Request`, `E.Bytes`, `P.Count`, `Roster.Check_Array`, and so on.

| R-QUAL | Each in the scope named *(sim)*. The simulation ran MQ1–MQ4, MQ8, MQ9 and MQ13 twice. With `CAPI_QUALIFIED` unchanged, (a) refused them by the multiset. With `CAPI_QUALIFIED` amended to match, (a) refused them by its table validation, or (b) did. MQ5, MQ6 and MQ10–MQ12 ran with the table amended, and the table validation, (c) or (d) refused them. MQ7 and MQ14 ran in the body only.
MQ1 `F.P.Decide` in `Finalization_Decide`.
MQ2 deeper renaming paths: `F.T.P.Decide`, `F.T.R.Decide`, `F.R.Old.Classify`, `R.T.P.Decide`, `K.A.Roster.Classify` and `Authority.Roster.Classify` in `Finalization_Decide`; `V.P.Decide`, `T.R.Decide` and `Raw_Roster.Old.Classify` in `Completion_Decide`; `V2.P.Decide` in `Pending_Decide_V2`; `CA.Roster.Classify` in `Completion_Metadata_Matches`.
MQ3 transport-qualified paths: `Pending_Transport.E.Decide` in `Pending_Decide_V1`; `Completion_Transport.P.Decide` in `Completion_Decide`; `Finalization_Transport.K.Decide_Value` in `Finalization_Decide_Mixed`; `Finalization_Transport.F.P.Decide` in `Pending_Decide_V2`.
MQ4 `Worldline.C_API.Pending_Transport.E.Decide` and `C_API.Finalization_Transport.F.P.Decide` in `Pending_Decide_V1`.
MQ5 one `Worldline.Recovery_C_API.Present` of `Recovery_Select` rewritten as `Recovery_C_API.Present`.
MQ6 `Evaluation_Pending_C.Decide_Value` of `Pending_Decide_V1` rewritten as `Standard.Evaluation_Pending_C.Decide_Value`.
MQ7 (body only, RESIDUAL; R-RES refuses too) `T.P.Decide`, `A.Roster.Classify` and `K.A.T.R.Decide` added to `Decide_Raw_Context`.
MQ8 library-unit paths: `Evaluation_Completion.P.Decide`, `Worldline.Evaluation_Authority.Roster.Classify`, `Evaluation_Pending_V2.P.Decide` and `Evaluation_Completion_C.A.Roster.Classify` in `Completion_Decide`.
MQ9 non-name prefix: `Request_Pointers.To_Pointer (Input).all.Header_Valid` in `Pending_Decide_V1`.
MQ10 attribute: `Evaluation_Pending_C.Decide_Value'Address` in `Pending_Decide_V1`.
MQ11 capture: declare `Evaluation_Pending_C : constant Integer := 0;` in `Pending_Decide_V1`; add `package Evaluation_Pending renames Evaluation_Pending_V2;` to `Pending_Transport`'s specification.
MQ12 removed routine: `Completion_Transport.Context_Matches` of `Finalization_Decide_Mixed` rewritten as `Evaluation_Completion_C.Context_Matches`.
MQ13 exception out of its scope: `Completion_Transport.Context_Matches` called from `Completion_Decide`.
MQ14 capture through the context clause: `with Worldline.Evaluation_Pending;` added to the C_API body's context (body only). |

| WF-X (R-GATE `wfx`) | *(sim)*:
MX1 (amendment) a third assignment `O := Evaluation_Finalization_C.Decide_No_Rows_Value (X, A, Required);` before the region.
MX2 (amendment) an `elsif` branch added to the region.
MX3 (amendment) `O` declared with an initializer.
MX4 (amendment) `O.Ok` read at the start of the then branch.
MX5 (amendment) `O.Value` selected before the region.
MX6 (amendment) a statement between the region's `end if;` and the test.
MX7 (body) the two assignments swapped.
MX8 (amendment) the else-assignment moved after `end if;` (`else null; end if; O := …;`). |
